_note: Episode 38 (Season 4) keyframes (from Kabanata 38, story version 2). The flood is fiction; no real disaster, office, party or company is shown; no readable text on any signs, vehicles or logos. Indio is 38, a senator: a few grey hairs. Rescues are hopeful and never gory; the child under the beam is pulled free. Sinag is the smiling man with pale gold eyes. Tubal is a generic man in a suit with a bronze ring. Bayanihan jump: a timeless rural scene, no year shown. Copied from Episode 13: full intro. Shots follow sentences.json; k90+ are montage extras.
